Volume Ambient Occlusion - SideFX
The Volume Ambient Occlusion SOP computes the ambient occlusion of the provided density field. It stores in a scalar field named occlusion how much each voxel sees its environment where 0 means there is no occlusion and 1 means fully occluded.
